'A sensational novel' – NetGalley

'I am so glad I got to read this wonderful book!' – Chells and Books Blog

'This would make a great holiday read' – Hinton Hits the Books Blog

A grieving mother. Secrets at the heart of the family. A love affair that could destroy everything …

Alicia and Liam's marriage is in trouble following the tragic loss of their only son. Hoping to heal, they travel to the Åland Islands, Alicia's peaceful Nordic homeland.

Enter Patrick, a charismatic Swedish reporter whose story of love and loss deeply connects with Alicia.

However, the small, quiet island hides unexpected secrets that force those closest to Alicia to reveal their hidden truths, offering Alicia a renewed purpose in life. Can she find love later in life?

The Island Affair offers a captivating mix of small-town romance and suspense, making it a top pick for fans of Elin Hilderbrand, Nancy Thayer, and Barbara Freethy. Set in an enchanting Nordic island community, this tale of loss, love, and self-discovery will leave you wanting more.

Pick your copy of The Island Affair today!
